sections.html:
• Serous fluid: Duct ectasia, Duct papilloma, Epithelial hyperplasia
  • Bloody fluid: Intraductal carcinoma, Duct papilloma
  • Galactorrhea — Microscope: Fat globule → Exclude Physiologic cause (Neonate, Pregnancy, Breast feeding) → Pathologic galactorrhea

• Breast Discharge
    • True galactorrhea (on microscopy) True Galactorrhea — on microscopy
      • Abnormal TSH/prolactin Abnormal TSH/Prolactin
        • High prolactin + normal TSH High Prolactin + Normal TSH
          • Microprolactinoma
          • Steroid Hormone Intake
          • Chronic Renal Failure
          • Stress (e.g. Pregnancy, Breast Stimulation, Trauma/Surgery)
        • High prolactin + normal/low TSH High Prolactin + Normal/Low TSH
          • Pituitary Macroadenoma
          • Dopamine Inhibition
          • Pituitary Stalk Compression/Lesion
        • Autonomous production Autonomous Production
          • Renal Cancer or Failure
          • Lactotroph Adenoma
          • Bronchogenic Tumor
          • Contraceptive Pill/Patch/Ring
        • High prolactin + high TSH High Prolactin + High TSH
          • Primary Hypothyroidism
      • Normal TSH/prolactin Normal TSH/Prolactin
        • Idiopathic
    • Other breast discharge Other Breast Discharge
      • Neoplasm (usually blood)
      • Other Internal Breast Discharge
